# MockPlayer

> Fake Player objects for tests.

- Package: `MockPlayer` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("MockPlayer")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("MockPlayer")` on the client

## `Gaxia.MockPlayer`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/MockPlayer.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local MockPlayer = Gaxia.MockPlayer
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local MockPlayer = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.MockPlayer)
```
